label: Genuine unity and simplicity in…: Genuine unity excludes all combination and composition
term: genuine unity and simplicity in Plotinus V.4
definition: Genuine unity excludes all combination and composition. It is not merely material atomism or the numerical singularity of an object. V.4.1 denies that bodies possess this first-principle simplicity, and V.4.2 denies it of Intellect. Its application to another ontology requires an explicit interpretation of the relevant composition.
